notes: `<details>` is the native disclosure widget: `<summary>` is a real button, reachable with Tab, toggled with Enter or Space, and announced as expanded or collapsed. Find-in-page can search the hidden text and open the section that contains it, which a hidden checkbox never could.
The accordion is the same markup with a shared name attribute: the browser keeps only one `<details>` of the group open, the job the 2014 radio buttons were doing.

The open and close animation targets `::details-content`, the slot that wraps everything after `<summary>`. `interpolate-size`: allow-keywords lets block-size transition to and from auto, so there is no max-height guess. It only runs when the user has not asked for reduced motion; elsewhere the sections simply snap open.
